response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer (15+ years) with strong fundamentals, testing culture, and open-source contributions, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. Hands-on C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the required 5-10 years, and there is no Windows-platform enterprise development, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. The nearest financial experience (RIDE Capital) was a Node/TypeScript/GraphQL fintech role rather than capital-markets systems work. The gap is on mandatory criteria rather than optional ones, so a screening pass is not warranted.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience with strong TDD, CI/CD, and low-latency systems work
Some fintech/investment domain exposure at RIDE Capital plus polyglot adaptability
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and courses taught
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, versus 5-10 years required
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking domain background
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform enterprise development evidence

key_factors.factor: SQL Server/Oracle and Windows platform experience
